integrity: Two independent complete finite verifiers and an embedded identical full catalogue; no claim of external certification.
scientific_limitations: Only binary fixed-length five-bit codes of cardinality six, with error-free block-count false-framing delay. Comma-free delay-one census was previously known; no result for other lengths or raw symbol delay. Bibliographic coverage is incomplete for certain early papers.
title: Complete bounded-synchronization-delay spectrum of binary five-bit capacity codes
